title: Idols of his youth: flute players and the charanga
summary: El Moro, Panchito and El Rubio were popular flutists; danzon played by charangas was the dominant music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay Macho, At that time were there any popular musicians who were idols in Cuba when, let's say, when you were ten or twelve?
Well, El Moro, a flute player - - -

El Moro - and there was Panchito, "Flauta Magica" - was El Rubio, those those fellows. El Rubio was a flute player from - from - he played with Antonio Maria Romeu; and then when the Rubio organized a jazz band to go to one of the high-class nightclub - ah ah - Antonio Maria Romeu took the "Flauta Magica", Panchito.
What was the popular music in Cuba at that time?
Were - - They were playing the Danzon?
